$comment: What a failed model call's STRUCTURED cause means to the pipeline — one place, read by every runner plugin (plugins/providers/failure-class.js). A class names what the attempt's handler does: credit and auth halt the story (every rung bills and signs in the same way), rate_limit and transient retry, the rest climb. A failure's WORDS are never read for its class (review of 2026-09-29): a vendor rewording, a translated message, or a model's prose quoted in an error must not flip a story into or out of a halt. A vendor's own codes live beside its plugin (plugins/providers/<name>/failures.json).

byStatus.$comment: HTTP status → class. A key of the form Nxx covers the whole hundred.

bySystemCode.$comment: Node's system error `code` on a thrown error (the request never got an HTTP answer).
